candidates.description: risk-off switch = (Sahm-like gap >= 0.5 p.p.) AND (12-month mean TB3MS at the origin >= 4.0 p.p.); in risk-off: point = BVAR_MINNESOTA point, quantiles = ENSEMBLE_INVERSE_MSE quantiles shifted by (BVAR point - inverse-MSE point); ENSEMBLE_INVERSE_MSE in full otherwise

flag.sahm_rule: 3-month mean UNRATE minus 12-month low of UNRATE >= 0.5 p.p. (as in v2/v3, unchanged)
flag.rate_rule: 12-month mean of TB3MS observed at the origin >= 4.0 p.p.
flag.threshold_rationale: 4.0 p.p. is the neutral pre-2008 level of the 12-month TB3MS mean; the condition is a post-diagnostic economic filter, not a result-tuned parameter

candidates.motivation: v3 (ENSEMBLE_REGIME_V3) passed C4 on both losses and both windows (RMSE 0.9734/0.9035, CRPS 0.9188/0.9329) and passed C1/C5, but failed C2 on W2 (adjusted p 0.2984 RMSE / 0.1494 CRPS). On W2 the Sahm rule stays active in 13 of 18 recession months and in the 2009-2011 tail, where the BVAR recession location does not beat the comparator significantly. The pre-run diagnostic shows that the flagged W2 months are zero-bound months (12-month TB3MS mean falls from 3.07 at 2008-06 to about 0.15 at 2009-12), while the W1_EXT flagged recessions are high-rate ones (1990-91: 5.6-8.0; 2001-09..11: 4.70). The rate condition therefore switches the risk-off branch off exactly where it was unhelpful (2008-09) and keeps it where the v3 C4 pass was earned (1990-91, 2001). Since the inverse-MSE ensemble already passed C4 on W2, no protection in W2 is lost.
candidates.design_disclosure: POST-DIAGNOSTIC design: the rate condition and its threshold 4.0 were chosen from the diagnostic of the flagged recession months above (TB3MS 12-month mean by origin) and from the published v1/v2/v3 results under the v5 protocol chain, not fixed independently of those outcomes. This is a disclosed researcher degree and is exactly why v4 is registered as a new candidate instead of changing any criterion. v4 is NOT a re-score of v1, v2 or v3, and does not retract their reports: all three remain published with their original numbers. The Sahm leg, target/horizon, evaluation criteria, windows and thresholds are unchanged; no weight, member, threshold or mapping was tuned against the v4 evaluation result, and the full construction (rate condition 12m TB3MS >= 4.0, BVAR location + inverse-MSE shape) was fixed before the run. Hypotheses fixed before the run: H1 C4 RMSE <= 1.00 on W1_EXT and W2; H2 C4 CRPS <= 1.00 on W1_EXT and W2; H3 C1 and C5 stay passed; H4 C2 passes on both windows (the failure v4 exists to remove).
candidates.note: registered before its own evaluation; evaluation report protocols/regime_v4_candidate_evaluation_report.json; v1, v2 and v3 remain published and are not re-scored
